title: Mask Adoption Diffusion Simulation
description: Simulate how face mask adoption spreads through a population under social influence, policy mandates, information campaigns, and market availability.

interactions.name: social_influence
interactions.description: Agents observe neighbors' masking behavior and update their adoption propensity via social proof or threshold rules.

interactions.name: household_norms
interactions.description: Within-household peer effects increase or decrease adoption based on household norm strength.

interactions.name: policy_influence
interactions.description: Mandates and enforcement by policymakers alter perceived cost/benefit and compliance behavior in affected locations.

interactions.name: location_enforcement
interactions.description: Locations with mask policies check compliance and may apply enforcement or fines, affecting future adherence.

interactions.name: market_transaction
interactions.description: Agents purchase masks from retailers subject to price, inventory, and rationing; availability constraints affect adoption.

interactions.name: media_exposure
interactions.description: Media channels broadcast messages that adjust agents' risk perception and trust, impacting adoption propensity.

interactions.name: observational_learning_in_public
interactions.description: Agents observe masking prevalence in locations and adjust their beliefs via descriptive norms.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Proportion of agents wearing a mask at each time step.

metrics.name: final_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Mask adoption rate at the final time step.

metrics.name: time_to_reach_70pct
metrics.description: First time step at which overall adoption reaches or exceeds 70%.

metrics.name: compliance_in_mandated_locations
metrics.description: Fraction of visits to locations with mandates during which agents complied with mask requirements.

metrics.name: stockout_rate
metrics.description: Share of retailer-days with zero mask inventory.

metrics.name: price_mean
metrics.description: Average mask price across retailers over time.

metrics.name: adoption_by_group
metrics.description: Adoption rates stratified by demographic group, income, or location type.

metrics.name: cascade_size_distribution
metrics.description: Distribution of social contagion cascade sizes inferred from first-adopter-triggered diffusion on the network.

metrics.name: gini_adoption
metrics.description: Inequality of mask adoption across groups measured via Gini coefficient.

metrics.name: cumulative_fines
metrics.description: Total fines issued due to non-compliance in mandated settings.
